about: Every event label and every claim about market structure on site/index.html, each with a primary source: the Federal Reserve, the New York Fed, Treasury, or a record in this repository. scripts/emit_visual.py reads this file and nothing in metadata/ carries these. tests/test_visual.py refuses an entry without a source URL.

events.text: FOMC ends balance-sheet runoff two months early, effective August
Fed announces Treasury bill purchases to keep reserves ample
Fed cuts rates to near zero and announces large asset purchases, on Sunday evening 15 March; the first business day to feel it is 16 March
IORB replaces IOER as the Fed's rate on reserves
Runoff ends, as announced on 29 Oct 2025
FOMC starts reserve-management purchases of bills

implementation_note.about: The current FOMC implementation note, fetched once and checksummed. Chapter 1 shows only the rates it states, parsed from these bytes; none is typed.

h8_release.text: The Federal Reserve Board publishes commercial banks' weekly balance sheets, total assets among them, in its H.8 release, generally on Fridays at 4:15 p.m. Eastern Time

tga_reserves.text: Reserves vary from day to day, most notably with swings in the Treasury General Account, the Treasury's own account at the Fed

dealer_balance_sheet.text: Around quarter-ends some dealers cut back parts of their repo activity, consistent with efforts to reduce the size of the balance sheets they report

mmf_on_rrp.text: Around quarter-ends, money market funds and other lenders in tri-party repo shift some of their lending into the Fed's overnight reverse repo facility

qe_sofr_rise.text: Fed staff wrote in June 2025 that SOFR had risen temporarily over each quarter-end since March 2023, and that the previous September and year-end it rose above the rate the Fed pays on reserves

qe_high_trades.text: Fed staff wrote in June 2025 that when SOFR rose above the rate paid on reserves, the previous September and year-end, a significant volume of repo trades took place at rates higher still

effr_spillover.text: In September 2019, pressure in the repo market spilled over into the federal funds market, and the effective federal funds rate moved above the top of the FOMC's target range

segments_tgcr.text: TGCR measures overnight tri-party general collateral repo backed by Treasuries, leaving out trades in which the Fed is a counterparty

segments_bgcr.text: BGCR adds the trades cleared through FICC's GCF Repo service

segments_sofr.text: SOFR adds the bilateral trades cleared through FICC's delivery-versus-payment (DVP) service, where each trade names the security it settles

segments_none.text: The three rates are built only from tri-party, GCF Repo and FICC-cleared DVP trades, so non-centrally cleared bilateral repo is in none of them

sofr_broad.text: SOFR is a broad measure of the general cost of financing Treasury securities overnight

sofr_trim.text: To keep trades for one scarce security from pulling the rate down, the New York Fed removes the lowest-rate 20 percent of DVP volume each day before taking the volume-weighted median

sofr_publication.text: SOFR is published at about 8:00 a.m. ET on the next business day, and may be revised at about 2:30 p.m. that day

triparty_actors.text: In the tri-party segment the largest borrowers are primary dealers, borrowing cash from money market funds to finance the Treasuries they hold

cleared_actors.text: In the centrally cleared segment, dealers lend cash on to hedge funds and other institutions

coupon_demand.text: Dealers and hedge funds borrow in repo to finance coupon Treasuries, so days when new coupon securities are issued raise the demand for repo cash

fed_cash.text: Reserves and overnight reverse repo balances are cash held at the Fed by banks and by non-banks respectively

standing_repo.text: In standing repo operations, dealers and banks can borrow from the Fed in a repo; their use helps limit upward pressure on repo rates

fhlb_fed_funds.text: Commercial banks and Federal Home Loan Banks are the main participants in the federal funds market, and the Home Loan Banks make up the vast majority of its lending

fhlb_both_markets.text: Federal Home Loan Banks lend in both the federal funds and the repo markets, and so link the two

reserve_ratio.text: New York Fed research measures reserves against total bank assets, and puts the point where reserves stop being plentiful at about 12–13% of bank assets

quarter_end.text: Around quarter-ends, and to a lesser extent some month-ends, some dealers scale back repo intermediation for regulatory and accounting reporting, and the spreads they charge widen

tax_date.text: On corporate tax dates, payments move from bank and money-fund accounts into the Treasury's account at the Fed, which drains reserves

settlement.text: When Treasury auctions settle, primary dealers pay for the securities they bought and finance them in repo, so more Treasuries need financing with the same cash

process.text: Work starts from a directive: an issue with a goal, acceptance criteria and the files to read
One session works one directive on its own branch, test first
The pull request is the report: what changed, the evidence, what was checked and what was not
A separate Claude review routine, not Eleonora, checks each acceptance criterion against the tree and merges; judgement calls go to her
A record is published only while nothing that computes a figure, declares a source or supplies the panel has changed since it was scored

guards.name: The as-of rule
guards.text: Each forecast reads every input at its latest value public at the decision time the day before, field by field

guards.name: Leakage and staleness guards
guards.text: A read newer than the decision instant raises LookAheadError; a read older than the latest admissible value raises StaleReadError

guards.name: The panel digest
guards.text: The panel rebuilds from tracked files and is refused unless its SHA-256 matches the published manifest

guards.name: A locked test period
guards.text: Recent days are held back from every model comparison until a phase verdict opens them

validation.text: An audit of the scoring code found that every published record had read its inputs later than they were public. That leaks nothing, but it is not what a forecaster at the decision time would have had, so every record was archived and re-scored under the as-of rule
